name: A blessing for your week
title: A blessing for your week
note: Blessing post, Psalm 20:1, 2 slides, no redraws
caption:
Someone you love is carrying a hard week. Send them this blessing.

This is an old prayer for anyone in a day of trouble, asking the God of Jacob to answer and to guard them. It is a good thing to pray over a friend who feels tired or worried right now.

Psalm 20:1 (BSB)

Save this for the week ahead.
